messages:
elaine: heads-up: deploybot scheduled MIG-9072 (tenant_metadata backfill + index populate) in tomorrow's midday slot. It's currently pinned to `quiet-slot` until 14:00 UTC but we want a shard-level canary earlier to validate new batching logic.
vik: what broke last time? locks or replica lag?
elaine: mainly index contention on tenant_id_idx + occasional temp btree growth causing VACUUM pressure. Staging showed p99 write jump and follower lag spike.
vik: proposed canary: shard=1 only, 8m run, start at 11:45 UTC. Metrics: replica_lag, db_write_p99, long_tx_count. Abort if replica_lag > 6s for 45s OR db_write_p99 > 600ms for 30s OR long_tx_count > 3.
elaine: added rollback steps in release note: https://rwd.example/release-notes/MIG-9072-canary. Rollback: `backfill abort MIG-9072 --shard=1` then `deploy pin MIG-9072 --tag=quiet-slot`. Also run `pg_replay_stats` if needed.
deploybot: To request unpin, include release-note link and monitoring owner ack. Run `/deploy request-unpin MIG-9072`.
vik: ack (oncall) if auto-abort hooks are wired and pg-ops pager is ready.
pg-ops: pager ready. ops contacts are oncall_pg_team. Auto-abort hooks will trigger and post to #incidents if fired.
monitoring-bot: Alert hooks registered: replica_lag, db_write_p99, long_tx_count. Will webhook to #eng-releases and page oncall.
elaine: submitted unpin: `/deploy request-unpin MIG-9072`
deploybot: Unpin request received for MIG-9072 by elaine. Approvals required: oncall ack (vik) + monitoring owner (elaine). Automated checks: no overlapping pins on tenant_metadata.
vik: approved. Start canary at 11:45 UTC. If any trigger fires, abort and re-pin.
elaine: starting canary at 11:45. I'll post updates at +2m, +5m.
monitoring-bot: +2m status: replica_lag=0.9s, db_write_p99=180ms, long_tx_count=0.
elaine: +5m status: still green. continuing.
monitoring-bot: +8m final: replica_lag peaked 1.2s, db_write_p99 peaked 210ms. Canary complete, promoting to wider shard rollout after 30m cooldown. :tada:
